meta.source_policy: Nur offizielle Microsoft-Quellen werden als verifiziert markiert. Forecast-Einträge sind getrennte Planungsschätzungen.

events.title: Microsoft Fabric workload usage becomes chargeable
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – Fabric usage update
events.summary: Free Fabric workload usage ends; usage counts against capacity limits and storage consumption becomes chargeable.
events.customer_rule: Fabric usage and capacity sizing should be reviewed before workloads exceed trial or existing capacity.

events.title: Realigning global licensing for Microsoft 365
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – Microsoft 365 Teams worldwide 2024
events.summary: Microsoft introduced no-Teams suites outside EEA/Switzerland and a Teams Enterprise standalone option for Enterprise customers. Existing customers with Teams suites could continue using and renewing existing subscriptions.
events.customer_rule: Net-new Enterprise purchases may need separate no-Teams suite plus Teams Enterprise; existing subscriptions need SKU-review at renewal or contract anniversary.

events.title: Power BI Premium per capacity SKU retirement
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – Power BI Premium licensing update
events.summary: Power BI Premium per capacity P-SKUs are removed for new customers from July 1, 2024; existing customers transition based on renewal and agreement type.
events.customer_rule: Existing P-SKU customers should plan a Fabric F-SKU transition at renewal or agreement end.

events.title: Microsoft Online Services pricing consistency update
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – Online Services pricing consistency
events.summary: Microsoft expands consistent pricing across Price Levels A-D for Online Services in EA and MPSA. Government and worldwide Education price lists are excluded.
events.customer_rule: Applies at next agreement renewal or when new Online Services not on the Customer Price Sheet are purchased from November 1, 2025.

events.title: Updates to Microsoft 365 licensing worldwide
events.summary: Teams-including Enterprise suites became broadly available again, no-Teams suites were reduced, and Teams Enterprise / Teams EEA standalone pricing was adjusted.
events.customer_rule: Treat as a packaging and SKU-structure event; only affected with-Teams, no-Teams and standalone Teams inventory should be marked relevant.

events.title: Power Apps per app license sales end
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – Power Apps per app end of sale
events.summary: Power Apps per app SKU is no longer available for new EA/MPSA purchases from January 2, 2026, with existing-customer and CSP exceptions described by Microsoft.
events.customer_rule: EA/MPSA customers should check agreement status and migration window; CSP customers are handled differently per Microsoft clarification.

events.title: Q1 local currency and price list adjustment review
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – local currency / price list review
events.summary: Local currency and price-list adjustments around February/March should be treated as a separate Q1 pricing context and not as part of the July 2026 Microsoft 365 packaging increase.
events.customer_rule: Review CSP, EA or partner price lists for February/March currency adjustments separately. This tracker records the context but does not write unverified FX changes into canonical SKU price_history.

events.title: Microsoft 365 Pricing and Packaging Updates
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – Microsoft 365 Pricing and Packaging Updates
events.summary: Select Microsoft 365 commercial suites and standalone components receive price updates effective July 1, 2026, with packaging changes beginning June 2026 and tenant notice before rollout.
events.customer_rule: Existing customers remain on current pricing until renewal; standalone Teams and Copilot SKUs are not part of this specific update.

events.title: Microsoft 365 Commercial Suites pricing and packaging FAQ
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – M365 pricing FAQ
events.summary: FAQ context for the 2026 Microsoft 365 commercial pricing and packaging changes, including scope, customer impact, packaging and product exceptions.
events.customer_rule: Use as context for scope and renewal interpretation, not as a separate price line unless a SKU appears in the pricing event.

events.title: Microsoft Services pricing consistency update
events.source_label: Microsoft Licensing News – Services pricing consistency
events.summary: Standardized pricing approach for Extended Security Updates for SQL Server and Windows products released on or after April 1, 2026.
events.customer_rule: Customers planning ESU for Windows or SQL Server should review deployment location, channel and modernization alternatives.
